name: Pavlov
text: Pavlov (German: Pollau) is a municipality and village in Břeclav District in the South Moravian Region of the Czech Republic. It has about 600 inhabitants.

depictions.name: Pavlov
depictions.text: real Yakov Pavlov Senior Sergeant Yakov Fedotovich Pavlov (Russian: Я́ков Федо́тович Па́влов) is a Russian soldier who fought to defend an apartment building, now named "Pavlov's House". In the game, his squad clears it out and holds it against German reinforcements for no more than twenty minutes.
